assets.prompt: Create a production game sprite SOURCE SHEET for Embergrave, a richly painted dark-fantasy isometric action RPG. Transparent RGBA background, no solid backing or checkerboard. Precisely a THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW grid, equal cells, with six isolated complete objects, generous transparent gutters, each wholly contained within its cell. No labels or text. Camera fixed isometric 2:1 (30 degree downward), viewing front and right faces, orthographic, consistent top-left light. Detailed painterly materials, grounded ruined architecture; no cartoon outlines, no UI. Row 1 from left: (1) wide rear ceremonial arch/backdrop with an open center, (2) shorter side monument/wall support, (3) dormant interactive device on a low plinth. Row 2 from left: (4) the exact same device, same size and viewpoint, activated with controlled magical glow, (5) a wide flat ceremonial FLOOR INLAY, seen at the same isometric angle, elliptical/diamond footprint and chipped transparent feathered edges, (6) a freestanding arena entrance gateway, open doorway. All are separate sprites, NO common ground between cells, no cropped edges. Hero and boss are NOT depicted. Theme: frozen octagonal sanctuary, pale granite, snow, cracked oath statues and cold blue ward braziers; amber embers restrained
